notes: This manifest is the canonical list of automated suites for Dungeoncrawler.
If the product also has language-native unit tests (e.g., PHPUnit), they can be included as suites here, but the PASS/FAIL contract must remain consistent.

suites.notes: Drush ev approach (authoritative until Playwright env provisioned). suites.label: Low-Light Vision — sense flag on character entity, Elf ancestry grants structured LLV (not plain string), dim-light concealment bypass, normal-vision baseline intact, darkvision wins when both set, LLV vs DV distinct effects, persist/reload, ancestry-switch clears/re-applies, non-existent character 404, client direct-write blocked, cross-character read blocked, E2E character sheet; TC-LLV-011/012 (new /senses route) implementation-dependent
suites.notes: Drush ev approach (authoritative until Playwright env provisioned). Pattern follows dc-cr-darkvision. IMPLEMENTATION-DEPENDENT: TC-LLV-011 and TC-LLV-012 require the /dungeoncrawler/character/{id}/senses GET route which does NOT exist in current routing.yml — probe-ignore until Dev implements. PM/Dev to decide: dedicated /senses endpoint vs filtered alias of /api/character/{id}/state. NOTE TO DEV: AncestryController currently maps ANCESTRIES['vision'] as plain string; must wire to FeatEffectManager::addSense('low-light-vision',...) at character load. TC-LLV-005/006 assume dc-cr-darkvision is implemented; if darkvision deferred, defer those TCs. Regression coupling: dc-cr-darkvision, dc-cr-elf-ancestry (TC-EA-004 assertion update), dc-cr-elf-heritage-cavern (sense replacement), ConditionManager.
